title: Sun or rain?

before.predict: Look at the picture and the title. What is the weather like?

text.title: Weekend Friends
paragraphs: Laylo: Good morning, friends! It’s really **sunny** today in Tashkent!
Bobur: Yes, and it’s very **hot**. It’s a great day for the park. Let’s play **football**!
Madina: Oh, let’s not play football. It’s too hot. Let’s go **swimming** at the pool!
Ali: Good idea! And then let’s ride our bikes in Navoi Park.
Laylo: OK! Let’s meet at the park gate at 10 o’clock.
Bobur: Wait! Look at the sky. It’s **cloudy** now, and it’s windy.
Madina: Is it **rainy** too? Oh no! Yes, it’s raining!
Ali: Let’s not go to the pool today. Let’s stay at home.
Laylo: Come to my house! Let’s watch a movie and play games.
Bobur: Great! My mom makes very good samsa. I can bring some.
Madina: Yum! I love samsa. And I can bring my new game.
Ali: See you at Laylo’s house at 11 o’clock!

tf: It is sunny in the morning.
Madina wants to play football too.
At the end, the friends go to the pool.
